text: ぜひ　ごじぶんで　さがされよ

patterns.name: 〜られる (respectful)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending here shows respect for the person doing the action, and the old-style よ makes it a dignified command. さがされよ = 'do seek them out'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after じぶん says who does the doing: on your own, without help. ごじぶんで = 'by yourself'.
